newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Walgreen target raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Walgreen target raised.

text.p: -- EVEREN said it raised its intermediate price target for Walgreen Co to $46 a share from $44, and its long-term target to $52 from $50.
-- It continues to rate the stock "outperform."
-- Walgreen today reported November same-store sales growth of 6.8 percent, and a rise in total sales for the month of 12.2 percent.
-- "These met our expectations and brought first quarter sales growth to 13.5 percent, and eight percent for comparable stores," EVEREN said.
